datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: This work uses the open-source Bijie landslide dataset to detect landslides using the DL method (Ji et al. 2020)... Figure 2 shows an image from the Bijou landslide dataset, which can be downloaded at http://study. rsgis. whu. edu. cn/ pages/ downl oad/.

methods.name: CAM-K-SEG
methods.summary: A segmentation framework that combines Grad-CAM visualization with K-Means clustering. It uses a pre-trained CNN (Resnet-50) to generate a heatmap via Grad-CAM, which is then processed by K-Means clustering to segment landslide areas.
methods.source: Kemal Hacıefendioğlu, Süleyman Adanur, Gökhan Demir
methods.verbatim: The source codes for developed code are available for downloading at the link: https://www. kaggle. com/ code/ datab eru/ fish- class ifier- grad- cam- viz- acc- 99- 89
